'''Blue corals''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They were collected by the [[Blue Coral Divers Clan/Legends|Blue Coral Divers Clan]].
